howto.title: How shortcut packs work
howto.one: When an app with a pack is in front (VS Code, Photoshop, Blender, Rainbow Six…), its shortcut keys glow in category colours.
howto.twoTitle: Hold Ctrl, Shift, Alt or Win
howto.two: After half a second only the shortcuts for that modifier stay lit, so you can see what Ctrl+B or Alt+F does without looking it up.
howto.three: Turn packs on in the list, edit them, or create one with “New pack”. Remaps and macros change what keys do; legends only light them.
